task.intent: Make the nightly export stop retrying forever when the vendor is down.

object.text: The nightly export job of the widget service.
object.artifact: The retry loop in the export worker.

confidence.question: Which export file is meant?
confidence.consequence: The wrong file would be changed.

standard.conditions: The retry path gives up after three attempts and leaves the queue unchanged.
evidence: The test log of the retry package.
The diff of the queue worker.

setup.output_branch_rule: A branch named hive/<task> cut from the source branch.
isolation: The working directory is the clone root.
The repository top level matches the binding.

boundary.scope: The export worker and its tests.
boundary.resources: One CPU hour of local test time.
boundary.permissions: Read and write inside the clone only.
stop_conditions: A test outside the worker fails for an unrelated reason.
boundary.repair_scope: The worker and its own tests.

channels.decisions: Ask the supervisor through a question.

output.deliverable: A branch holding the retry change and its tests.
completion_evidence: The branch name and head revision.

definition_of_done.stopping_point: The branch is pushed and the evidence is written; the worker stops there.

supersedes_reason: The steer narrowed the scope to the export worker.
